go-api-contracts.reason: The existing public configuration and CLI contracts are exercised without creating or changing them.

go-core-style.reason: Writing Go tests and private helpers requires idiomatic Go style and compatibility with the declared version.

go-interfaces-and-composition.reason: No interfaces, constructors, dependency wiring or production resource lifecycle are changed.

go-package-boundaries.reason: Tests stay in the existing external test package, with no package or responsibility changes.

go-test-isolation.reason: Tests mutate process environment, own temporary executable files and run bounded child processes; unset and present-empty values require faithful restoration.
